oferta.title: Offer – Websites, E-commerce and CRM Systems | Maxsoft Zielona Góra
oferta.description: Maxsoft's detailed offer: creating websites, responsive online stores (PrestaShop, WooCommerce), CRM/ERP systems and API integrations. Services for companies in Zielona Góra and Świebodzin with SEO optimization.
oferta.heading:
Design of Company
Management Systems
oferta.ofertatxt2: We specialize in creating CRM, ERP systems, but we also handle smaller projects like website creation. We create every project individually, paying attention to details and ensuring it meets your expectations. We also provide comprehensive service: development, optimization, updates, and ongoing technical support. Many years of experience allow us to implement various types of projects that stand out for their functionality and effectiveness.
oferta.ofertatxt5: We implement and configure CMS (content management), CRM (customer relationships, sales pipeline) and ERP systems (business processes: warehouse, production, finance). We match the solution to your organisation’s size – from straightforward rollouts to deep integration with tools you already use. We train your team, provide documentation, updates and ongoing technical support so the system can grow with your business.
oferta.ofertatxt7: We design and build corporate sites, services and landing pages – from WordPress-based themes to bespoke solutions tailored to your industry. We focus on responsive, mobile-first layouts, fast loading, readable content and technical SEO foundations. We set up editing workflows for your team, integrate forms and analytics, and after launch we handle updates, extensions and security maintenance.
oferta.ofertatxt9: We design database structures, normalisation, indexes and queries for performance and growing data volumes. We work with relational engines (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle) and non-relational stores where it fits (e.g. MongoDB). We run environment migrations, tune slow queries, plan backups and advise on technology choices for each project – e-commerce, CRM or custom web applications.
oferta.ofertatxt11: We build and evolve online stores on PrestaShop, WooCommerce (WordPress) and Magento, depending on catalogue scale, ERP integration needs and hosting constraints. We configure products, payments, shipping, branded themes and integrations with couriers and wholesalers. For a full service breakdown, see our dedicated E-commerce page.
oferta.ofertatxt13: We cover domain hosting, DNS setup, e-mail, file and database space, and FTP/SFTP access. We help choose a plan that matches traffic and app requirements (PHP, databases, SSL certificates), monitor service health and support site migrations between providers. We also assist with backups, updates and server-level hardening where needed.
oferta.ofertatxt15: We help you pick the right certificate (including free Let’s Encrypt or commercial options), install it on the server or hosting panel and enforce HTTPS for all traffic. We fix mixed-content issues, set up redirects and, when useful, security headers such as HSTS. SSL builds user trust, is required for online payments and supports good practice and GDPR-aligned handling of personal data in transit.
oferta.ofertatxt17:
In our company, we apply a unique approach to designing CRM systems and creating websites.
We believe in creating with user experience and functionality in mind.
oferta.ofertatxt19: SSL affects user trust, data security, and is often a requirement for online payments and compliance with data protection regulations (GDPR).
oferta.ofertatxt23: Updates for your company website + 24/7 support from a team of experts. Free valuation and quick quote.
oferta.ofertatxt25: Our productions are characterized by original ideas while maintaining the highest technical and visual standards.
oferta.ofertatxt27: A CRM system supports marketing, sales, and service. Build better customer relationships. Everything in one place without Excel.

oferta.ofertatxt34: Customer relationship management with client data centralization. They allow for the streamlining of sales processes.
oferta.ofertatxt36: Management of key business processes such as finance, HR, production, logistics, and sales.

We design stable integrations, token security and data flows aligned with your processes. See the Integrations page for details.

ecommerce.title: PrestaShop & WooCommerce E-commerce Zielona Góra | Stores, WordPress themes, payments
ecommerce.description: PrestaShop and WooCommerce stores, WordPress themes, plugins and updates. Payment integrations Przelewy24, PayU, BLIK – Maxsoft, Poland.
ecommerce.heading: E-commerce PrestaShop & WooCommerce
ecommerce.intro1: At Maxsoft we implement and grow online stores on PrestaShop and WooCommerce on WordPress – two of the most popular e-commerce stacks in Poland. We match the technology to your scale, ERP integrations and SEO goals.
ecommerce.intro2: Below you will find our services as a structured list – PrestaShop and WooCommerce, ending with payment integrations with major Polish providers.
ecommerce.listIntro: Implementations, themes, modules, plugins, updates and payments – tailored to your store and hosting.

ecommerceItems.title: PrestaShop-based online stores
ecommerceItems.description: We implement PrestaShop stores tailored to your industry – catalogues and combinations, cart and checkout, courier and warehouse integrations, and ERP connectors. We focus on responsive layouts, fast loading and clear conversion paths.

ecommerceItems.title: PrestaShop themes (templates)
ecommerceItems.description: We build and customise PrestaShop themes: premium templates and brand-specific adjustments – colours, typography, home, listing and product pages. We optimise for Core Web Vitals and Google guidelines.

ecommerceItems.title: PrestaShop store updates
ecommerceItems.description: Regular PrestaShop updates keep your store secure and compatible with payment and shipping modules. We upgrade core, modules and themes with backups and staging tests. We also help after failed updates or module conflicts.

ecommerceItems.title: PrestaShop modules
ecommerceItems.description: We implement PrestaShop modules: payments, shipping, invoicing, CRM, price comparison feeds, wholesaler integrations (XML/CSV/API), marketing and analytics. We choose proven modules or build custom integrations.

ecommerceItems.title: WooCommerce online stores (WordPress)
ecommerceItems.description: We build stores on WooCommerce – the WordPress e-commerce extension suited to mid-scale projects and fast launches. We configure products, variations, tax and shipping, courier integrations and basic product SEO. WooCommerce fits when you need the WordPress ecosystem and plugins without replacing the whole engine.

ecommerceItems.title: WooCommerce themes
ecommerceItems.description: We customise and build WooCommerce themes: product pages, shop archives, cart and checkout aligned with your brand. We optimise themes for speed and mobile; with Elementor, Gutenberg or classic themes we wire sections so they stay stable after WooCommerce updates.

ecommerceItems.title: WordPress themes
ecommerceItems.description: Beyond the shop we design WordPress themes for corporate sites, landing pages and content hubs – on the same install as WooCommerce or a separate site. We keep brand consistency, accessibility basics and technical SEO (headings, structure, performance).

ecommerceItems.title: WordPress and WooCommerce plugins
ecommerceItems.description: We install, configure and connect plugins: payments, shipping, invoicing, SEO (e.g. Yoast, Rank Math), security, cache, backups, CRM and wholesaler integrations. We pick proven extensions or custom integrations; we avoid plugin conflicts and respect production licences.

ecommerceItems.title: WooCommerce theme, template and store updates
ecommerceItems.description: We regularly update WordPress, WooCommerce, themes and plugins – security patches and compatibility with payment gateways. We use backups, staging tests and fixes after conflicts (e.g. theme vs. new WooCommerce). We also help migrate to newer PHP versions and hosting.

ecommerce.pPaymentsIntro: For PrestaShop (modules) and WooCommerce (plugins) we integrate payments using official extensions or reliable API integrations. Below is a list of major Polish (and widely used in Poland) online payment operators with modules/plugins or ready integrations (informational – availability depends on your store version and the provider’s offer):
ecommerce.paymentsNote: BLIK, cards and online transfers are usually offered through the gateways above. We verify compatibility with your PrestaShop or WordPress/WooCommerce version and hosting before go-live.
paymentItems: Autopay (formerly Paynow – e.g. Bank Millennium, Santander Group)
Allegro Pay / Allegro ecosystem payments (indirect integrations)

seo.title: SEO, Google Ads, Facebook & TikTok Marketing | Maxsoft Zielona Góra
seo.description: SEO, Google Ads, Facebook and Instagram ads, TikTok Ads and organic traffic growth. Digital marketing services for businesses in Zielona Góra, Świebodzin and across Poland.
seo.heading: SEO & marketing
seo.intro1: At Maxsoft we combine solid websites and stores with marketing: SEO in Google, paid campaigns (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok) and strategies to grow organic traffic. We match channels to your industry, budget and goals – from brand awareness to leads and sales.
seo.intro2: Below we outline each area: SEO, search and social ads, and activities that support natural traffic on your site. You can run them standalone or as one coherent plan.
seo.listIntro: Pricing and strategy depend on competition, market and your current site. Contact us to align on goals and the right mix of activities.

serviceItems.title: SEO (search engine optimisation)
serviceItems.description: Optimisation for search: technical audit, site structure, keywords, content and internal linking. We aim for sustainable visibility in Google for queries that matter to your business – with transparent reporting and a realistic roadmap, not empty “guaranteed #1” promises.

serviceItems.title: Google Ads campaigns
serviceItems.description: Account and campaign setup: Search, Shopping, Performance Max where appropriate, plus remarketing. We structure ad groups, match keywords to budget, track conversions and optimise continuously so spend goes to clicks that can convert.

serviceItems.title: Facebook & Meta advertising
serviceItems.description: Campaigns on Facebook and Instagram: audiences, boosted posts, lead ads and conversion objectives. We help with the Meta Pixel, events and website/store integration so you can measure results and grow awareness or inbound leads.

serviceItems.title: TikTok Ads
serviceItems.description: Advertising on TikTok for brands targeting younger audiences and short-form video. We support ad account setup, creatives that fit the platform and simple goals: traffic, app installs or awareness.

serviceItems.title: Growing organic traffic
serviceItems.description: Long-term growth without relying only on ad spend: content (blog, landing pages), UX and page speed, internal linking and technical health aligned with Core Web Vitals. Organic traffic compounds when SEO and site quality move together.

serviceItems.title: Analytics, reporting & optimisation
serviceItems.description: Google Analytics 4, Search Console, goals and e-commerce events. Regular summaries: where traffic comes from, what converts, where to invest more in SEO or ads. Decisions are data-driven.

seo.ctaTitle: Quote for SEO or ad campaigns
seo.ctaText: Tell us what you need (SEO, Google Ads, Meta, TikTok) – we will propose scope and timeline.

integracje.title: API Integrations Zielona Góra | Facebook, Instagram, Meta, OLX, Otodom, InPost, DPD | Maxsoft
integracje.description: API integrations: social media (Facebook, Instagram, Meta Marketing), OLX, Otodom, real estate, InPost and DPD logistics. Maxsoft experience in Zielona Góra and Poland.
integracje.heading: API Integrations
integracje.intro1: At Maxsoft we have extensive experience connecting websites, online stores and CRM/ERP systems with external services via API. We implement integrations with the Meta ecosystem (Facebook, Instagram), advertising tools, classified portals and courier operators – with a focus on stability, token security and clear data flows.
integracje.intro2: Below are short descriptions of selected APIs we work with: from social media and Meta ads, through OLX and Otodom (including support for agencies and developers in sales and rentals), to InPost and DPD in e-commerce logistics.
integracje.listIntro: Every implementation is tailored to your stack, API permissions and business requirements. Contact us to discuss scope and pricing.

integrationItems.title: Facebook Graph API
integrationItems.description: Access to pages, posts, comments, lead forms and basic insights. We connect your Facebook Page with the website or CRM to capture leads and sync content without manual copy-paste.

integrationItems.title: Instagram Graph API
integrationItems.description: Business account features: publishing and scheduling, basic metrics and linkage with Facebook in the Meta ecosystem. Useful for marketing and social automation.

integrationItems.title: Meta Marketing API
integrationItems.description: Automation of Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns: ad sets, targeting, budgets and reporting. For setups where ads must tie into your own panel or store.

integrationItems.title: OLX API
integrationItems.description: Synchronisation of classified listings between OLX and your system or website – less manual work and consistent data. We help with authorisation and API limits.

integrationItems.title: Otodom API
integrationItems.description: Integration of property sale and rental listings with Otodom for agencies, developers and industry sites – easier listing on the portal without duplicating entries everywhere.

integrationItems.title: InPost API
integrationItems.description: Label generation, parcel tracking, Paczkomat map and checkout integration. Solutions for e-commerce and shipping-heavy businesses.

integrationItems.title: DPD API
integrationItems.description: Shipment booking, parcel tracking and integration with warehouse or store workflows. We support shipping automation and buyer notifications.

integracje.ctaText: Describe your system (website, store, CRM) and target API – we will propose the connection and estimate the work.
